source.author: ov
source.text: Mox ego, ne scopulis haererem semper in isdem, addidici regimen dextra moderante carinae flectere et Oleniae sidus pluviale capellae Taygetenque hyadasque oculis arctonque notavi ventorumque domos et portus puppibus aptos.
source.text_original: Mox ego, ne scopulis haererem semper in isdem, / addidici regimen dextra moderante carinae / flectere et Oleniae sidus pluviale capellae / Taygetenque hyadasque oculis arctonque notavi / ventorumque domos et portus puppibus aptos.
source.text_english: Soon I myself, lest I should always cling to the same rocks, learned to steer the ship, with my right hand guiding the helm, and I observed with my eyes the rainy star of Olenian Capella and Taygete and the Hyades and the Bear, and the homes of the winds and harbors suited to ships’ sterns.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: illam Acamans habitat nudusque Pyragmon, has nimbi ventique domos et naufraga servat tempestas.
reuse.text_original: illam Acamans habitat nudusque Pyragmon, / has nimbi ventique domos et naufraga servat / tempestas.
reuse.text_english: Acamans dwells in that place, and naked Pyragmon too; these homes are preserved by storms and winds and by shipwrecking tempest.
